title: Intent in professional and social settings
shortTitle: Intent in professional and social settings
summary: The chapter places context beside outward wording and formal reservation.
notes: Cohen, family arrangements, social rides, and informal business negotiations test different reasons for treating words as binding or otherwise. A reservation of formal execution should be distinguished from merely expecting a later writing. A letter of intent can define an enforceable process while disclaiming an ultimate deal. The full later precontractual-liability unit remains outside this import.
